4880.title: Move freeze incorrectly clears the live connect account
4880.rootCauseOneLine: Connect maps the server-moving 503 to account unavailable, causing AccountLink to clear the account and tear down the tunnel.
4880.proposedFix: Preserve 503 server_moving as a transient account RPC error so the existing retry loop keeps the live account and tunnel.
4880.caveats: The actual freeze/SDK path and local plugin/tunnel lifecycle were reproduced twice; a complete macOS-to-Ubuntu server migration was not performed.
